시편 10:1.content: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

시편 10:2.content: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

시편 10:3.content: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.

시편 10:4.content: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

시편 10:5.content: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

시편 10:6.content: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

시편 10:7.content: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

시편 10:8.content: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

시편 10:9.content: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

시편 10:10.content: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

시편 10:11.content: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

시편 10:12.content: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

시편 10:13.content: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

시편 10:14.content: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

시편 10:15.content: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

시편 10:16.content: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

시편 10:17.content: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

시편 10:18.content: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
